mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, we are seeing 78 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Harriet Park. Tonight, the moon is a waning crescent, and you can spot the ISS starting at 8:17 PM as it rises over Belleville and heads toward the Fitchburg and Madison area. Expect an overnight low of 70 degrees with rain on the way.

The Verona Fire Department invites you to an open house on Saturday, September 19, from 10 am to 2 pm at 101 Lincoln Street. It is a great opportunity to tour the station, meet your local firefighters, and participate in important safety demonstrations.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, visit the studio for yoga at Insight Wellness, catch live music at Paddy Mac's, or join trivia nights at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they received information regarding an inappropriate relationship involving a school staff member that occurred in 2019. Following an investigation, 34-year-old Halla Nelson was arrested on September 4 on one count of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently open, so head over before they close at 10 pm to enjoy your treat.
